title: Feminismos del Sur
author: Feminismos del Sur
description: In a conversation, the journalist Ester Pinheiro delves into and echoes decolonial voices of resilience and resistance from a gender perspective. This is a multilingual podcast, we have episodes in Spanish, Portuguese, English, and French. Follow our profile on Twitter @Feminismsdelsur, Instagram @feminismosdelsur and contact us at feminismsdelsur@gmail.com. Our website: https://www.feminismosdelsur.com/en
